tasks.title: Separate logical cell history from physical group consensus

steps.action: Add dependency-free CellHistory, GroupHistory, CellKey, CellVersion and route/membership epoch types. Specify canonical hash bytes and infinity bounds exactly as design.md. Add private adapters while existing consumers still compile; do not introduce a public legacy/shared mode flag.

Encode cell-addressed data and typed administrative entries under new marker-1 semantic domains. Reject unknown tags, duplicate identity fields, oversized declarations and wrong cell/schema/route before allocation or application.

Define version tokens and receipt provenance around stable cell incarnation and monotone mutation sequence. Preserve transfer compatibility within one cell history; refuse old-incarnation and cross-cell tokens. Wire validation through owning Result types.
Add golden byte/negative tests and bounded decoding fixtures. Map the new module through existing lib.rs paths; keep raft-rs, I/O and serde out of cellar-logic.

tasks.title: Prepare paged range routing and enrollment admission

steps.action: Implement immutable paged range-tree records and one conditional namespace-root mutation journal. Verify complete range coverage, no overlap and exact epochs. Initial explicit ranges can be lazily materialized using existing birth and permanent disk-claim rules.

Define the pure enrollment decision and codec around the current range, cell creation identity and schema. Concurrent proposals must converge on one cell history when committed. This task validates admission decisions only; CG-04 connects those decisions to the actual multi-cell group owner and independent SQLite initialization.

Make physical replica/log identity, engine registry and durable mappings, node storage inventory and permanent member claims group-scoped, without a synthetic cell name. Connect the exact verified birth to synced real-engine genesis before permitting voter startup. Reject old storage domains rather than adding a legacy decoder. Reconcile lost birth/root/enrollment replies by canonical operation identity. Keep unconfirmed outcomes typed; a blank claimed voter cannot bootstrap under a new path. Refuse enrollment under sealed or retired ranges. Metadata-only birth tests do not satisfy this integration boundary.
Add bounded tree traversal/cache tests, restart races and stale-route redirects with original deadlines/hop budgets. Ordinary known-group commands must not require an S3 catalog request.

tasks.title: Execute many independent SQLite cells through one real Raft group

steps.action: Split the combined host Cell owner into group consensus state and per-cell execution state. One GroupHistory owns exactly one RawNode per voter; cell count does not allocate additional RawNodes. Reuse shared persistence, transport and SQL pools. Integrate CG-03 enrollment decisions with replicated enrollment and independent SQLite initialization before exposing cell commands. Atomically retain the immutable enrollment creation record with the selected cell state; preserve it through mutations and transfer so retries never reinitialize or restore the initial image over newer state. Consume the prepared CellRoutingSession attempts when integrating dispatch: preserve the logical request fingerprint, original domain deadline and total attempt budget across member retries and group redirects. Catalog-confirmed mappings are hints; destination admission must validate the full binding and current authority. Command producers remain domain-owned after a routing waiter is cancelled.

Admit one unresolved proposal per cell with fair cell queues and group/node byte quotas. Allow independent cells to prepare concurrently, then publish committed entries through one contiguous group prefix with per-cell base/version checks. Enforce configured group enrollment capacity on the actual owner before append, counting applied cells and pending accepted logical creations. Exact creation retries consume no additional slot; competing creations cannot exceed the limit before apply. Verify capacity refusal leaves existing cells available and release reservations only with proven resolution.

Implement exact per-cell output settlement and receipt retry. Group no-ops/configuration entries advance group apply without changing cell version. Reject stale term/activation/completion tickets and preserve unknown proposed outcomes. Check the prepared term atomically with proposal admission on the actual Raft owner. Bind same-term acceptance retries to the original proposal identity and bytes; a lost acceptance response must recover retained acceptance or reconcile the original receipt without appending the same mutation again. Reject changed payloads under a reused identity, and retain uncertainty across elections until an applied barrier proves resolution. A definitive pre-append owner refusal must irreversibly seal all clones of that preparation before returning an identity-bound rejection proof. Generic queue errors cannot retire a submitted SQL producer. Close rejected producers on their owning worker before releasing name admission; delayed retries and proofs from another preparation must not affect a replacement producer.

Implement Stale, AtLeast and current-term ReadIndex for the target cell. Pin coherent manifest/image views and include cross-cell noninterference and slow-apply cases in the real-engine fixture. Correlate each strong read to its own runtime-owned request context and absolute domain deadline; retain separate bounded node/group pin admission through delivery and physical SQL execution. Configure logical image-pin bytes independently of transport message/request bytes; validate overflow and supported image bounds, and test independent capacity and reservation cleanup. Persist each selected version's full commit witness in the authenticated manifest and require exact proposal matching at apply. Keep original decision provenance separate from local installation position, retain it across unchanged-cell progress/restart and carry it through query and receipt observations. Missing witness fields must refuse at marker 1. Query callbacks consume immutable pins on existing workers, preserve read-only SQL policy and contain panics. Deadline/cancellation must interrupt SQLite work while arbitrary callback ownership remains retained until it finishes; shutdown joins that work.

Run physical group apply on the existing node SQL workers with independent bounded progress admission. Transfer the startup manifest-page owner, verify the exact committed entry/base, prepare either cell image representation and derive bounded scheduling summaries. Retain preparation through response cancellation and physical publication. Materialized retries may pin only the exact verified prepared image; they cannot infer publication or reset retirement. Test the physical image store retry across restart and corruption, and reject malformed effect tables rather than reporting idle. Keep membership/topology administrative apply explicitly refused until its owning tasks implement it.

Qualify image and manifest I/O ownership at actual held/failing directory barriers. Recover complete cell-group images through the same stable physical naming and verified extent bindings used by apply; accept only the engine-selected root and retain its exact cell versions/witnesses. Cold restart may replay a committed unpublished entry but never substitutes selected files or inherited commit state for fresh serving authority. Missing closure refuses before owner admission. Keep whole-process kill/power-loss qualification distinct from joined cold restart.

Use logical CellHistory at registered command and signed-effect identity boundaries. Dispatch namespace-authorized classes on the existing shared SQL workers; validate operation, schema, input and authenticated inbox identity before receipt lookup. Preserve exact proposal submission/settlement and cancellation ownership. Group placement is absent from effect identity; fresh cell incarnations remain fenced. Marker-1 old group-bearing effect wire and old signature domains refuse. Catalog/SDK dispatch remains separate integration work.

Dispatch compiled queries through the existing coherent query worker and callback guard with the actual CellVersionObservation, bounded operation/input admission and original read deadline. Keep legacy group cuts explicitly typed during integration; never fabricate a cell sequence or witness. Remove the temporary group-cut observation and old constructor with CG-16; final serving uses the common cell-group path.

Connect catalog routing sessions to compiled query execution with a namespace-bound class and captured input/consistency. Share bounded invocation admission across dispatcher clones, preserve the original domain deadline and total retry budget, consume each attempt before entering asynchronous work, authenticate AtLeast cell tokens and return a token for the selected observation. Exact destination route and engine checks remain mandatory; a confirmed catalog redirect cannot invent a physical owner. Dropping the routing invocation must leave entered SQL owned until joined cleanup. Command/enrollment dispatch and final public SDK replacement remain required.

Route immutable registered command invocations through the same dispatcher and catalog sessions. Capture host time/randomness once, retain the original runtime/SQL producer across cancelled preparation, and resume it before considering a new destination. Submission acceptance is provisional; settle only an exact committed receipt or the existing newer-term absence proof. Preserve command identity, deadline and attempt budget across retries, and refuse S3 requests or S3 namespace minima until a real archive proof is integrated. The production controller must retain active invocations and drive publication; enrollment and the public SDK/controller cutover remain required.

Connect physical group histories to the existing node-owned peer transport without constructing the legacy runtime. Share TLS pools, lanes, byte/item banks, revocation and joined shutdown. Bind typed marker-1 history and full replica identity to authenticated requests/responses; refuse old untagged wire layouts and unsupported group snapshots. Include physical routes in all resource and endpoint-conflict checks. The temporary legacy runtime/frame adapter must be deleted with the old host in CG-16. Qualify actual multi-group replication and routed command settlement over TLS before integrating the production controller.

tasks.title: Cut public SDK routing and managed fleet over to shared groups

steps.action: Switch the existing public host/startup/registration APIs to group placement plus cell enrollment. Preserve cell-addressed application calls and explicit query consistency. Remove production creation of one RawNode for each ordinary cell.

Adapt managed namespace import, capacity accounting, repair, drain, maintenance and topology inventory to group replicas plus separate cell/image occupancy. Reuse existing CAS journal, permissions and disruption debt; do not bypass managed admission.

tasks.title: Implement irreversible source sealing and destination activation

steps.action: Implement Planned/Prepared/SealAuthorized/Sealed/Installed/Published/Active/Retired journal states from protocols.md. Seal authorization and pre-seal cancellation CAS the same state; no source Seal request is allowed before authorization wins.

Commit parent seals after accepted mutations, block new enrollment/writes/strong reads, and pin the exact cell/effect/receipt cuts. After SealAuthorized only roll forward, including unknown replies and partially sealed merges.

Seed fresh non-serving child group histories with preserved CellHistory/versions/receipts/effect IDs. Require child quorum install receipts and an atomic range-tree publication certificate before committed child activation. Publish and verify a complete remote transfer closure before changing active ranges; pin its digest in the publication certificate so all-voter loss immediately after publication remains recoverable.

Persist stale-authority tombstones and transition resources across controller/leader/node restart. Release source data only after all child baseline archives and physical pins are safe; no timer may reopen the parent.

tasks.title: Coordinate group hibernation and authority-checked wakeup

steps.action: Implement PreparePark and generation-bound local durable park/closed records. Require all configured voters to acknowledge the committed applied cut, with explicit learner state and no unresolved proposal/read/topology work.

Pause routine group ticks only after the exact park certificate is durable. Keep node transport/control/effect wake owners active and bounded; partial park delivery must be safe and stale certificates must never re-park a woken group.

Wake on API/peer/effect/topology activity or restart, durably close the park generation, resume retained Raft and obtain fresh current-term commit/read authority. Never reset votes, assume retained leadership or replace a missing quorum with S3.
Integrate alarm due indexes, membership serialization, cancellation and shutdown. Measure healthy cached wake, image-cache restore and leader-loss wake separately with enough samples.
